newsitem.title: USA: COMSAT acquires Intelcom Mexico unit.
newsitem.headline: COMSAT acquires Intelcom Mexico unit.

text.p: COMSAT Corp said Thursday that it has acquired full ownership of Mexican corporation IntelCom Red SA de CV, a wholly owned subsidiary of ICG Satellite Services Inc, and named it COMSAT Mexico SA de CV (COMSAT Mexico).
Terms of the acquisition were not disclosed.

COMSAT Mexico, said the company, will be part of COMSAT International, a business unit of COMSAT Corp that provides digital network services to corporate customers and carriers in rapidly growing international markets.

COMSAT Mexico, said the company, holds a teleport license for both domestic and international satellite communications and will provide digital networking services through its teleport in Mexico City.

The company's entry into the Mexican market, it said, will allow it to provide corporate customers with advanced digital networking services in the three largest Latin American economies -- Argentina, Brazil and Mexico. Combined with its presence in Bolivia, Colombia, Guatemala, Peru and Venezuela, COMSAT said it can now offer customers digital networking services virtually anywhere in Latin America.
